title: Resume advice
transcript: how far back should a resume go a general rule of thumb is anything older than 10 to 15 years is okay to cut out now of course that doesn't apply to everybody if you have that much experience that's awesome but if you just graduated from college and are looking for your first career job first up well done and two don't feel like you need a bulk your resume to hit 10 years experience 2 to 3 years experience for example is completely acceptable just make sure whatever you do have listed is relevant to the career you are going for
